Nov 12, 2026 10:00 AM
Eastern time
Receiving, verifying, and evaluating academic records from around the world is easier when you know the services behind them. Join us for a TAICEP At Your Desk session on the document provider services that credential evaluators, admissions teams, and records professionals rely on.
Representatives from the following providers will walk through their services and answer your questions:
100Transcripts
TrueCopy
MyEquals / My eQuals / Parchment Digitary Services (previously known as Digitary|CORE)
EduCerts
What you’ll learn
What each provider offers and how their services work
How these services fit into your evaluation or admissions workflow
What to consider when comparing providers
Where to go for more information or next steps
And more!
